animations.name: Hurt Medium
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Start and end in the exact supplied standing guard pose. Animate a smooth, continuous medium stomach-hit reaction spread evenly across the full clip with clear intermediate frames: first the fighter takes a hard blow to the stomach, driving the abdomen back while the upper torso hunches forward, shoulders curl inward, head drops with a pained grimace, knees bend, and both arms drop briefly toward the midsection as the guard breaks; then he absorbs the impact in a controlled staggered hunch without falling; finally he smoothly straightens his torso, lifts his head, and raises both fists back into the exact standing guard pose. Keep both feet grounded on the baseline without sliding out of frame. Preserve Oscar's face, black outfit, sneakers, scale and pixel art. Locked camera, no zoom, no hit sparks, no props or effects.
